jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is responsible for translating CII's strategy into execution by ensuring the organization has the systems, processes, accountability, and infrastructure necessary to deliver its mission effectively and sustainably.
  

  

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the COO provides executive leadership for enterprise operations, compliance, data and analytics, technology governance, and organizational effectiveness, driving cross\-functional integration and continuous improvement across the organization.
  

  

In partnership with the CEO, the COO strengthens organizational capacity, removes barriers to performance, and enables CII to achieve its strategic priorities at scale.**DUTIES**
==========

**SUMMARY**


The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is responsible for translating CII's strategy into execution by ensuring the organization has the systems, processes, accountability, and infrastructure necessary to deliver its mission effectively and sustainably.


As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the COO provides executive leadership for enterprise operations, compliance, data and analytics, technology governance, and organizational effectiveness, driving cross\-functional integration and continuous improvement across the organization.


In partnership with the CEO, the COO strengthens organizational capacity, removes barriers to performance, and enables CII to achieve its strategic priorities at scale.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Enterprise Compliance, Risk Management \& Organizational Accountability**

* Provides executive oversight of enterprise compliance, risk management, and internal controls to ensure regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and organizational accountability.
* Establishes and monitors processes to identify and mitigate financial, regulatory, technology, and reputational risks.
* Oversees corrective actions arising from audits, investigations, licensing reviews, accreditation findings, and other compliance matters.
* Partners across the organization to strengthen controls and ensure effective implementation of policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensures timely escalation and reporting of significant risks, findings, and corrective actions to the CEO and Board, as appropriate.
**Enterprise Operations \& Strategic Execution**

* Leads enterprise operational planning and execution in support of CII's strategic priorities.
* Establishes governance structures, decision rights, and accountability mechanisms that support effective execution and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Leads enterprise process improvement and major cross\-functional initiatives to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and service quality.
* Removes organizational barriers and resolves complex operational challenges that impede performance.
**Data, Analytics \& Performance Intelligence**


* Provides executive oversight of enterprise data and analytics to ensure timely, accurate, and actionable information for decision\-making.
* Establishes metrics, dashboards, and reporting systems aligned with strategic goals and organizational performance.
* Promotes data governance, shared information practices, and evidence\-based decision\-making across the organization.
* Partners across functions to integrate data and reduce siloed reporting.
**Technology Governance \& Digital Transformation**

* Provides executive oversight of enterprise technology governance and digital transformation to ensure technology investments support organizational priorities and operational effectiveness.
* Oversees relationships with outsourced technology providers and ensures accountability for service delivery, cybersecurity, and business continuity capabilities.
* Leads technology\-enabled process improvement, systems integration, and organizational change initiatives.
* Ensures appropriate governance of information privacy, technology risk, and cybersecurity through internal oversight and external service providers.
**Program Integration \& Organizational Effectiveness**

* Ensures effective integration across programs, operations, data, and infrastructure to improve organizational performance and reduce duplication.
* Partners with program leadership to design operating models that support scale, quality, and consistency of service delivery.
* Standardizes core processes while preserving flexibility and innovation.
* Leads enterprise change management efforts that strengthen adoption, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.
**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Leads and develops high\-performing teams across operations, compliance, data and analytics, facilities, and related administrative functions.
* Builds a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and enterprise thinking.
* Serves as a strategic advisor to the CEO and Board on organizational performance, enterprise risk, and transformation initiatives.
* Fosters collaboration and shared ownership of organizational outcomes across the Executive Leadership Team.
**ADDITIONAL DUTIES**

* Other duties and special projects as assigned.

**PERFORMANCE EVALUATION \& ACCOUNTABILITY**


The COO reports to the CEO and is accountable to the Executive Leadership Team. Annual performance will be evaluated based on the achievement of key performance indicators in:

* Execution of the strategic plan and achievement of enterprise milestones
* Operational efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability
* Data quality, analytics adoption, and performance transparency
* Systems reliability, security, and alignment with strategy
* Program integration and cross\-functional collaboration

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

**49ers STEM Leadership Institute Program Director (Full time)**
================================================================


Silicon Valley Education Foundation (SV\[e]F) is the largest educational nonprofit in Silicon Valley. Our mission is to deliver and advocate for equitable STEM education that inspires and prepares students for college and careers. We are guided by the belief that all students are capable of pursuing higher education and boosting their future economic mobility regardless of their background. SV\[e]F has an established legacy of providing proven STEM programs and being profoundly committed to empowering students to graduate high school career and college ready. The impact of our work is evident in our strong partnerships with districts and donors in closing the achievement gap and the creation of a workforce that has the skills to meet 21st century needs.


### **POSITION SUMMARY**


**Program Overview**


The 49ers STEM Leadership Institute (SLI), created in partnership with the San Francisco 49ers, Silicon Valley Education Foundation (SV\[e]F), and the Santa Clara Unified School District (SCUSD), is a six\-year program that will prepare students with high academic potential to be outstanding.


SLI began in Summer 2014 with a cohort of 60 incoming seventh grade students. A new cohort of 60 incoming seventh graders is selected through a competitive application process each year, and students advance with their cohort to the next grade level. By the end of the six\-year rollout process, there will be a total of 360 students from grades 7 – 12 involved in the program, located at two state of the art digital fabrication labs at Cabrillo Middle School and Santa Clara High School in the Santa Clara Unified School District. Students complete a rigorous college preparatory curriculum, engage in STEM projects and competitions, and participate annually in 300\+ hours of additional learning time.

  

  

**Program Director – 49ers STEM Leadership Institute**


Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Silicon Valley Education Foundation (SV\[e]F), the Program Director provides strategic, operational, and programmatic leadership for the 49ers STEM Leadership Institute (SLI). The Director oversees the program in its entirety across grades 7–12 and works closely with SV\[e]F leadership, Program Managers, Program Coordinator, SCUSD administrators and teaching staff, the 49ers Foundation, corporate and university partners, students, and families. The Program Director serves as the central point connecting the many organizations and individuals involved in SLI and is responsible for ensuring that the program remains student\-centered, operationally strong, financially sustainable, innovative, and aligned with the goals of SV\[e]F, SCUSD, and the 49ers Foundation.

  

  

### **CLASSIFICATION**

  

### **POSITION TYPE**

  

### **REPORTS TO**

  

### **MAJOR DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Strategic Leadership \& Program Direction**


* Own the overall strategy, direction, priorities, and continuous improvement of SLI.


* Translate SV\[e]F and partner priorities into actionable annual and multi\-year program plans.


* Evaluate existing programming and identify opportunities to continue, improve, expand, redesign, or discontinue initiatives based on impact and available resources.


* Develop and refine the student journey from 7th through 12th grade, ensuring intentional progression in STEM skills, leadership, design thinking, project\-based learning, career exploration, and student development.


* Identify emerging STEM, technology, education, and workforce trends and determine how they should influence SLI programming.


* Contribute to SV\[e]F organizational strategic planning and represent the needs, opportunities, and priorities of SLI.

  

  

**Program Operations**


* Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of the entire SLI program across middle and high school.


* Develop and maintain sustainable policies, SOPs, workflows, calendars, systems, and accountability structures.


* Coordinate school\-year programming, Extended Hours, Open Lab, workshops, field experiences, competitions, showcases, partner programs, and special initiatives.


* Ensure FabLab operations, equipment access, safety expectations, training, scheduling, materials, and replenishment support program needs.


* Identify operational risks and resolve issues before they significantly affect students, families, teachers, or partners.


* Ensure institutional knowledge and critical processes are documented rather than dependent on individual staff members.

  

  

**Team Leadership \& Staff Development**

* Build staff capacity so that program operations do not become overly dependent on the Director.

  

  

**SCUSD \& Teaching Team**


* Serve as a primary liaison between SV\[e]F/SLI and Santa Clara Unified School District.


* Maintain relationships with district leadership, school administrators, principals, counselors, teachers, and other school personnel.


* Partner with SLI teachers on curriculum planning, student pathways, Extended Hours, student performance, interventions, professional development, and program expectations.

jobs.description:
**PRC Baker Places** is a non\-profit residential treatment agency that has provided the San Francisco community with alternatives to institutional care since 1964\. Our direct care professionals provide counseling and case management services to previously homeless adults living with co\-occurring diagnoses of chronic mental illness and substance use disorder. All agency services are provided from the philosophy of social rehabilitation which integrates teaching daily living skills in a safe and healthy environment.

**Mission Statement:** Our mission is to help people affected by HIV/AIDS, substance use, or mental health issues better realize opportunities by providing integrated legal, social and health services that address the broad range of social risk factors that impact wellness and limit potential.

**Values that Guide Us:** Accountability, Honesty, Integrity, Diversity \& Inclusion, Respect

 **Position Overview**


The Residential Services Program Director is an intermediate management role responsible for implementing the organization’s mission, vision, and strategic priorities into actionable plans and measurable results. This role provides support to the 90\-day residential program managers and is a bridge between the programs and the Senior Management Team.

  

The Residential Services Program Director partners closely with program managers and the Senior Management Team to achieve an excellent standard of client care and staff support.

 **APPLICATION Deadline: Friday, February 20th, 2026 by 5:00 pm**

* Provide supervision and support to Program Managers, including weekly supervision and evaluation.
* Work with the Intake and Placement Department to maintain contracted units of service.
* Serves as the Administrator for all CCL licensed programs.
* Plans, organizes, and directs clinical services of 90\-day programs.
* Responsible for the administrative function of 90\-day programs.
* Works closely with Senior Management Team and Program Managers to adhere to program budgets and needed supplies.
* Ensures program functions smoothly within the larger behavioral health system by building and maintaining relationships with community partners.
* Oversees documentation by clinical staff in collaboration with agency Quality Improvement and performs periodic audits of charts to ensure adherence to licensing and certification standards.
* Establishes and maintains a recovery culture and philosophy within the program.
* Prepare and submit monthly clinical status reports for all programs to the Senior Director of Clinical Services.
* Participates in hiring, orientation and annual performance evaluations of program managers.
* Provides crisis response and intervention, including rotating on\-call and after hours assistance.
* Promote agency mission, purpose, and values in relationships with internal and external providers.
* Participate in any managers meetings with Social Programs to foster a wrap around services environment.
* Additional duties as assigned.

 **Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Active licensure or registration in good standing with the California Board of Behavioral Sciences (BBS) as one of the following: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC), Associate Clinical Social Worker (ASW), Associate Marriage and Family Therapist (AMFT), Associate Professional Clinical Counselor (APCC), or licensed Psychologist (Psy.D.).
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in the community mental healthcare/substance use disorder/HIV\-AIDS or integrated healthcare setting. A minimum of three (3\) years of supervisory and/or management responsibilities of clinical staff.
* Self\-motivated and directed, demonstrate strong relationship\-building skills, have experience with infrastructure development and hold a high value for diversity.
* Demonstrated effective management and leadership skills with diverse populations.
* Ability to establish collaborative partnerships with supervisees, colleagues, and community organizations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Knowledge and understanding of trauma\-informed and other evidence based therapeutic principles/practices.
* Flexibility, adaptability, and ability to focus attention on workflow processes, procedures, budgetary guidelines, and documentation/productivity standards.
* Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines.
* Must be available to work flexible hours occasionally – including possible nights and weekends.
* Proficiency with Microsoft products required
* Exhibit exemplary customer service, compassion, and care in the execution of all duties and interactions.

 **Salary and Benefits:**


This is a full\-time, exempt position. PRC Baker Places offers a competitive salary plus medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their eligible spouse/children, as well as short/long\-term disability, life insurance, employer\-matching contributions to 403(b) retirement, generous paid time\-off, and professional development.

**Help shape the future of learning. Build the partnerships that make it possible.**

  

KID Museum is at an exciting inflection point. Over the past decade, we have grown from a beloved local museum into a nationally recognized learning lab that develops, tests, and shares innovative approaches to helping young people thrive in a rapidly changing world. We work at the intersection of education, creativity, technology, workforce readiness, and youth development, engaging thousands of students, educators, families, and community partners every year.

This is more than a traditional fundraising leadership role. We're looking for an entrepreneurial relationship\-builder, strategist, storyteller, and fundraiser who is energized by creating opportunities, opening doors, and turning vision into investment. You'll help shape how KID Museum shows up with philanthropists, institutional funders, corporate leaders, government supporters, and education innovators while building the philanthropic engine that fuels our mission.

* Join a mission\-driven organization at a pivotal moment of growth

* National funders
